visualBrief: The Crimean Tatar palace in Bakhchysarai, with its painted North Gate, twin stone minarets and mosque arcade, carved and latticed palace wings, Falcon Tower, fountains and domed tombs.

references.role: North Gate pointed opening, arched lattice, paired rosettes and ochre red eaves
Tall stone minarets, annular balconies and pointed caps, stone arcade and painted decoration
Mosque staircase, near minaret and courtyard-facing palace gallery
Painted eaves, lattice, summer balcony and courtyards
Falcon Tower with polygonal timber cage and tiled roof
Precinct, tombs and visible architectural components

limitations: Photo-based reconstruction of the visible historic precinct, based principally on 2007–2014 views. Recent restoration and temporary equipment are outside the model.
PMTiles places the surrounding palace ranges. Minaret and mausoleum offsets, ornaments and individual graves are approximated from mapped points and photographs. Interior rooms are outside the model.
Standard Terrarium supplies the ground datum. Courtyard relief and the path at the North Gate can vary with host terrain.
